validation.scheme: Leave-location-out cross-validation: GroupKFold(5) over 91 spatial clusters of the 97 monitors (monitors closer than 150 km are always held out together), so every prediction is for a location the model never saw. Metrics on out-of-fold daily means in µg/m³.
validation.temporal_scheme: New locations and future months: each location fold is trained on its training clusters before 2024-12-01 (22,864 monitor-days in total) and tested on the held-out clusters from 2024-12-01 to 2025-02-28 (7,675 monitor-days).

generalization.scheme: Leave-region-out (each of the 9 world regions held out)
